LicenseActivation.title: LicenseActivation
LicenseActivation.description: Stores subscription activation code bindings, device fingerprint, usage timestamps, transfer history, and revoked devices in Firebase Firestore.

isUsed.description: Whether the subscription code is currently active and bound to a device.

deviceId.description: Unique hardware device ID currently authorized for this subscription code.

deviceFingerprint.description: Multi-factor hardware and browser device fingerprint hash.

deviceName.description: Human-readable name of the currently bound device.

storeName.description: Store name associated with the subscription.

durationLabelAr.description: Arabic label describing the subscription duration.

usedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the code was used or transferred to the current device.

firstActivatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the code was first activated.

expiresAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the subscription expires.

transferCount.description: Total number of times activation was transferred between devices.

revokedDeviceIds.description: Bounded list of device IDs whose subscriptions were revoked/cancelled.

lastRevokedDeviceId.description: Device ID of the most recently revoked device.

lastRevokedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the previous or unauthorized device subscription was cancelled.

/licenseActivations/{codeId}.description: Global registry of subscription codes bound to device fingerprints in Firestore.
